propositions: Never-pushed managed local links with vendor-type collisions cannot be distinguished from peer-deleted links in the inbound removal path, causing order-dependent incorrect removals

Outbound ADD dedup on (vendor_type, target_key) without relation granularity creates a blind spot where a collision causes a local link to never be pushed and remain unprotected by outbound differ suppression
A durable peer-confirmation record must be persisted and checked in _inbound_unlink_one to decline removal of never-peer-confirmed managed links
Peer confirmation must be recorded on successful outbound link ADD and populated from authoritative fetched snapshots with completeness tracking to distinguish absence from non-evidence
Existing managed links must be backfilled as confirmed-at-upgrade so the first post-upgrade reconciliation pass does not incorrectly decline legitimate removals
